about: Catalog skill -> O*NET tasks of the Anthropic Economic Index. Drafted by Claude on 2026-10-30 from keyword candidates; each entry is used only after a team member sets reviewed: true (checkpoint 2). Tasks are the exact task statements of the source files.

data-analyst.title: Data Scientists
data-analyst.note: O*NET puts Business Intelligence Analysts (15-2051.01) under this code

ml-engineer.title: Computer and Information Research Scientists
ml-engineer.note: closest code; the SOC has no separate ML engineer

product-manager.title: Computer and Information Systems Managers
product-manager.note: approximate; the SOC has no product manager

forward-deployed-engineer.title: Software Developers
forward-deployed-engineer.note: approximate; a new role without its own code

teacher.title: Secondary School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education

sql.reason: 写数据库查询是 SQL 的核心工作
tasks: write computer programs or scripts to be used in querying databases.
extend existing software programs, web-based interactive tools, or database queries as sequence management and analysis needs evolve.

excel.reason: 用电子表格制图、制作报表和文件
tasks: draw charts and graphs, using computer spreadsheets, to illustrate technical reports.
prepare invoices, reports, memos, letters, financial statements, and other documents, using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or presentation software.

statistics.reason: 用统计方法分析数据并报告结果
tasks: analyze data from surveys, old records, or case studies, using statistical software.
compute and analyze data, using statistical formulas and computers or calculators.
report results of statistical analyses, including information in the form of graphs, charts, and tables.

python.reason: 用程序语言做数据分析和写分析程序
tasks: perform system analysis, data analysis or programming, using a variety of computer languages and procedures.
design and create special programs for tasks such as statistical analysis and data entry and cleaning.

data-cleaning.reason: 写程序做数据录入和清洗
tasks: design and create special programs for tasks such as statistical analysis and data entry and cleaning.

data-visualization.reason: 把分析结果做成图表和报告
tasks: compile reports, charts, or graphs that describe and interpret findings of analyses.
prepare documentation or presentations, including charts, photos, or graphs.

communication.reason: 向客户或管理层报告和解释发现
tasks: present and explain proposals, reports, or findings to clients.
produce reports or presentations that outline findings, explain risk positions, or recommend changes.

html-css.reason: 用 HTML 等网页语言开发和维护网页
tasks: develop transactional web applications, using web programming software and knowledge of programming languages, such as hypertext markup language (html) and extensible markup language (xml).
review or update web page content or links in a timely manner, using appropriate tools.

javascript.reason: 为网页应用写程序代码
tasks: write supporting code for web applications or web sites.
develop transactional web applications, using web programming software and knowledge of programming languages, such as hypertext markup language (html) and extensible markup language (xml).

react.reason: 开发网页应用的用户界面
tasks: write supporting code for web applications or web sites.
design customer interface of online storefront, using web programming or e-commerce software.

git.reason: AEI 数据中没有版本控制相关的 O*NET 任务，不硬套；显示「无来源」

accessibility.reason: 让网页在不同设备和浏览器上可用
tasks: optimize digital assets, such as text, graphics, or multimedia assets, for search engine optimization (seo) or for display and usability on internet-connected devices.
evaluate code to ensure that it is valid, is properly structured, meets industry standards, and is compatible with browsers, devices, or operating systems.

api-integration.reason: 设计系统之间的接口和数据传输
tasks: identify methods for interfacing web application technologies with enterprise resource planning or other system software.

design database applications, such as interfaces, data transfer mechanisms, global temporary tables, data partitions, and function-based indexes to enable efficient access of the generic database structure.

backend-language.reason: 用面向对象语言开发服务器端应用
tasks: use object-oriented programming languages, as well as client and server applications development processes and multimedia and internet technology.
develop new software applications or customize existing applications to meet specific scientific project needs.

databases.reason: 设计和维护数据库结构
tasks: design database applications, such as interfaces, data transfer mechanisms, global temporary tables, data partitions, and function-based indexes to enable efficient access of the generic database structure.
create and maintain accessible, retrievable computer archives and databases, incorporating current advances in electronic information storage technology.

rest-api.reason: 网页应用与其他系统之间的接口（O*NET 没有专门的 REST 任务，只找到这一条）
tasks: identify methods for interfacing web application technologies with enterprise resource planning or other system software.

cloud-deploy.reason: 配置服务器、安装和维护软件
tasks: configure servers to meet functional specifications.
perform ongoing hardware and software maintenance operations, including installing or upgrading hardware or software.

testing.reason: 测试程序、更新自动化测试脚本
tasks: update automated test scripts to ensure currency.
test programs or databases, correct errors, and make necessary modifications.
test system modifications to prepare for implementation.

user-research.reason: 设计调查、整理访谈和调查结果
tasks: develop criteria for the design and modification of survey instruments.
compile, record, and code results or data from interview or survey, using computer or specified form.

prototyping.reason: 制作网页模型和原型（AEI 未观察到 AI 使用，渗透率为 0）
tasks: create web models or prototypes that include physical, interface, logical, or data models.

figma.reason: 制作网页图形、版面和用户界面
tasks: develop graphics and layouts for product illustrations, company logos, and web sites.
design customer interface of online storefront, using web programming or e-commerce software.

visual-design.reason: 运用线条、色彩等视觉元素做设计
tasks: integrate and develop visual elements, such as line, space, mass, color, and perspective, to produce desired effects, such as the illustration of ideas, emotions, or moods.
design complex graphics and animation, using independent judgment, creativity, and computer equipment.

usability-testing.reason: 评估软件可用性并向开发者反馈
tasks: provide feedback and recommendations to developers on software usability and functionality.
develop mathematical or statistical models of phenomena to be used for analysis or for computational simulation.
formulate mathematical or simulation models of problems, relating constants and variables, restrictions, alternatives, conflicting objectives, and their numerical parameters.

ml-frameworks.reason: 开发和应用机器学习算法
tasks: develop or apply data mining and machine learning algorithms.
process large amounts of data for statistical modeling and graphic analysis, using computers.

mlops.reason: 测试、维护和监控上线的程序与系统
tasks: test, maintain, and monitor computer programs and systems, including coordinating the installation of computer programs and systems.

roadmapping.reason: 制定产品和业务计划、验证产品潜力
tasks: develop or revise business plans for online business, emphasizing factors such as product line, pricing, inventory, or marketing strategy.
plan or conduct market or public opinion research to test products or determine potential for product success, communicating results to client or management.

agile.reason: 协调团队和外部人员推进系统计划（O*NET 没有敏捷开发的专门任务）
tasks: coordinate implementation of computer system plan with establishment personnel and outside vendors.

market-analysis.reason: 收集和分析竞争对手与市场情况
tasks: gather data on competitors and analyze their prices, sales, and method of marketing and distribution.
monitor market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales.

accounting.reason: 记账、整理财务记录和编制财务报表
tasks: classify, record, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals and ledgers or computers.
perform accounting duties, such as recording daily cash flow, preparing bank deposits, or generating financial statements.

auditing.reason: 编写审计发现和审计报表
tasks: prepare detailed reports on audit findings.
compile statistical, financial, accounting, or auditing reports and tables pertaining to such matters as cash receipts, expenditures, accounts payable and receivable, and profits and losses.

internal-control.reason: 检查记录的合规性、评估风险
tasks: review records for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with regulations.
analyze and classify risks and investments to determine their potential impacts on companies.
research and analyze laws, regulations, policies, and precedent decisions to prepare for hearings and to determine conclusions.
apply relevant laws, regulations, policies, or precedents to reach conclusions.

legal-writing.reason: 起草诉状、合同和法律备忘录
tasks: prepare legal documents, including briefs, pleadings, appeals, wills, contracts, and real estate closing statements.
prepare briefs, legal memoranda, or statements of issues involved in cases, including appropriate suggestions or recommendations.
negotiate the sale, lease, or development of property and complete or review appropriate documents and forms.
prepare contracts or negotiate revisions to contractual agreements with architects, consultants, clients, suppliers, or subcontractors.

lesson-planning.reason: 编写教学目标、大纲和教案
tasks: prepare instructional program objectives, outlines, and lesson plans.
develop instructional materials, such as lesson plans, handouts, or examinations.

classroom-management.reason: 主持和引导课堂讨论（AEI 未观察到 AI 使用）
tasks: initiate, facilitate, and moderate classroom discussions.

assessment.reason: 出题、评分、评估学生进度
tasks: prepare, administer, and grade tests and assignments to evaluate students' progress.
evaluate and grade students' class work, performances, projects, assignments, and papers.

clinical-knowledge.reason: 根据检查结果诊断、制定治疗方案
tasks: analyze records, reports, test results, or examination information to diagnose medical condition of patient.
develop individualized treatment plans for patients, considering patient preferences, clinical data, or the risks and benefits of therapies.

patient-care.reason: 记录病史、与其他医护人员交接病人信息（实际照护病人的动作不在 AEI 数据中）
tasks: document patients' medical histories and assessment findings.
write information in medical records or provide narrative summaries to communicate patient information to other health care providers.

medical-ethics.reason: 保护病人隐私、遵守保密的伦理规范
tasks: develop or implement policies or practices to ensure the privacy, confidentiality, or security of patient information.
follow ethical codes that protect the confidentiality of information.

cooking-technique.reason: 烹调食物（AEI 未观察到 AI 使用，渗透率为 0）
tasks: bake, roast, broil, and steam meats, fish, vegetables, and other foods.
read food order slips or receive verbal instructions as to food required by patron, and prepare and cook food according to instructions.

food-safety.reason: 按卫生和安全规范准备食物（AEI 未观察到 AI 使用）
tasks: prepare daily food items, and cook simple foods and beverages, such as sandwiches, salads, soups, pizza, or coffee, using proper safety precautions and sanitary measures.

menu-planning.reason: 规划菜单定价、开发食谱
tasks: plan and price menu items.
create specialty dishes and develop recipes to be used in dining facilities.

engineering-math.reason: 用计算机做复杂的工程计算（O*NET 没有专门的结构力学计算任务）
tasks: perform complex calculations as part of the analysis and evaluation of data, using computers.

cad.reason: 用 CAD 绘制图纸、读懂技术图纸
tasks: prepare scale drawings or architectural designs, using computer-aided design or other tools.
read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, or computer-generated reports.

project-management.reason: 制定和监控项目进度、预算和计划
tasks: prepare or monitor project schedules, budgets, or cost control systems.

develop or update project plans for information technology projects including information such as project objectives, technologies, systems, information specifications, schedules, funding, and staffing.
